title: RoundTable: a table where six AI voices deliberate, review and edit code with a human
description: RoundTable is a workbench where AI models from different labs (Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Moonshot, DeepSeek, Google) sit at one table with a human: they answer blind (answers are held in the conductor's memory and revealed at once), rebut each other under anonymous labels, take turns in an executor's chair to edit a git repository under a lease, and merge only through a review gate with quorum bound to the exact reviewed sha. The leader of each round is chosen by a commit-reveal lottery over the public drand randomness beacon. Published deliberately as dated prior art.
